purpose: Rejection record for pairing two output columns in the Q8 four-row path

experiment.description: Pair two output columns in the Q8 four-row loop so x-row loads serve both weight columns. Each output's per-group partial-accumulator reduction order (a+b)+(c+d), tails and scale application kept bit-exact.
experiment.reason: Preserving the 4-partial-accumulator group reduction forces 32 live accumulators for two columns x four rows; register spilling dominates any shared-load benefit (up to 4.6x slower at larger shapes). Consistent with the earlier Q8 remainder-row column-pairing rejection (~1.02-1.05x) and the FP32 sixteen-accumulator rejection.
